records.head: 0bf1f8309e8425ba34199657009d3055215336f1
records.reason: Complete branch accounting found narrow, compatible source controls still absent; no wholesale donor merge is appropriate.

paths.reason: Current retains dual-OS QA, Windows build/portable/installer checks, both release-side checksum verifications, immutable third-party release action and tag-aware name. Donor-only concurrency protection, separate uploaded-artifact validation and if-no-files-found:error remain absent. Split jobs/pip cache/image path exclusions are alternative workflow policy, not automatic ports; current qt-gate and no-release requirements must survive.

Current describes the retained matrix/build-before-upload architecture. Donor split-job, post-upload validation and cancellation-protection prose has no current implementation. The donor tag-aware name and both-checksum wording are accurate current behavior but absent from this older pipeline paragraph; current acceptance spec/tests already record the tag behavior.

Tag-specific release naming is explicitly recovered in the current specification. Donor separate Windows package/validation jobs are absent; current specification instead requires matrix QA, qt-gate and Linux smoke and describes status recording after final Windows acceptance.

Donor updates a dated release-action observation. Current actual action is SHA-pinned and maintained test enforces it; the dated source-observation table remains historical, with continuation amendments explicitly separating historical observations from current acceptance.

Donor pins setuptools and eight QA packages to its 2026-10-30 environment. Current keeps bounded ranges except existing PyInstaller pin and adds PyYAML. These old exact versions do not establish cross-platform transitive hashes and must not replace the current manifest without dependency-closure/version validation.

Added exact build/dev-pin assertion is absent and fails unchanged against current ranges. Existing maintained packaging checks pass. Preserve this original regression as evidence for a future selected locking policy, not a fabricated CODEX-5 closure.
Donor added Setup.exe size/digest listing test. Current retains the test and additionally checks its exact SHA-256; unchanged donor addition passes.

Commit-pin assertion is retained verbatim. Donor split-job dependencies/PR gates/downloaded-byte checks/concurrency tests are absent or changed. Current release-dependency test instead enforces qt-gate and no-release control. Original changed tests yield 6 failures and 3 passes across 9 cases, preserved without xfail conversion.
Entire file byte-identical, including LF-only checksum regression; unchanged donor addition passes.
Entire file byte-identical; ASSET_NAMES includes Setup.exe and produces size/SHA-256 evidence.
Entire file byte-identical; write_checksum emits LF-only bytes and main calls it after checking the installer exists and is nonempty.

records.head: 7ac57759f3b9b332eaafb48c82f366566892f1b1
records.reason: All 13 paths and all donor behavior/contracts/regressions are retained or superseded by stricter maintained source; no unique missing compatible implementation found.

paths.reason: Donor resources/** LF rule is narrowed to the actual retained patchtrace-mark.svg. That is the only resource introduced by this branch; its Git blob is identical and LF handling remains explicit.
Current dedicated Application mark and Windows executable identity rows register every donor runtime/build module, tests, and the boundary that native readback is CI-only.

Current WIN-1 continuation plus acceptance/staging amendments retain metadata, mark, unsigned identity and default-manifest behavior while adding strict readback and staging requirements. Historical statements remain dated; no donor completion claim is substituted for current qualification.
The donor package-data declaration patchtrace = resources/*.svg is present unchanged. Other current dependency changes are outside this donor hunk.
Application window icon and missing-icon self-test failure remain. Current moves the optional-dependency summary print after the icon check; no donor icon behavior is lost.
Entire file byte-identical; owner SVG loading/rendering and window icon construction are retained.
Entire SVG blob byte-identical; existing test verifies equality with the site owner mark.

17 of 19 branch-added/changed top-level symbols are AST-identical. Two original tests call the old three-argument checker API and fail with the added required numeric quad; maintained replacements use full version evidence and valid icon payloads. Current file has 72 passing cases; original complete file gives 33 passes/2 disclosed interface failures.

pyinstaller_command is AST-identical. Main preserves generated icon/version inputs and readback, but validates fields before build work, checks packaged SVG identity and supplies expected numeric version quad to the stronger checker.

Current checker preserves label, commit, unsigned publisher and icon checks and additionally rejects incomplete/contradictory version evidence, mismatched fixed file/product versions and malformed/missing icon payloads. Its API now requires the expected numeric quad, with CLI --build support; the two original test failures are deliberate API supersession.
Entire hook byte-identical; packaged SVG and QtSvg inclusion retained.
ICO render/packing functions are AST-identical. CLI output switches from predictable .tmp naming to exclusively created adjacent random stages with cleanup; output semantics retained.

Current retains VersionFields, label/run rules and rendering. It requires full 40-character lowercase commit identity and full matches, rejects trailing controls, and uses exclusive random adjacent staging with failure cleanup. No missing compatible donor behavior found.

group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.ref || github.run_id }}

recovery_candidates.evidence: Original donor test_runs_that_can_publish_are_never_cancelled_by_a_newer_run fails against current source. Current group is workflow/event/ref with cancel-in-progress:true.
recovery_candidates.bounded_followup: Review and recover only the conditional cancellation/run-id grouping plus its contract and regression. Preserve all current jobs, triggers, action pins, qt-gate/no-release dependencies and artifacts. Source reasoning alone does not prove hosted scheduler behavior.

recovery_candidates.evidence: Donor windows-validate downloads the uploaded Windows artifact, verifies both sidecars, unpacks and runs frozen/portable/installer checks before release. Current performs those acceptance checks before upload, then verifies sidecars again in release, with no download-and-smoke gate.
recovery_candidates.bounded_followup: Evaluate a narrow post-upload validation step/job against current qualified topology; preserve existing native and Qt gates. Do not copy the old whole workflow. Native/hosted qualification remains required.

recovery_candidates.evidence: Donor Windows upload sets if-no-files-found:error; current Windows upload leaves the action default. Current packaging and later release checksum checks still provide distinct safeguards.
recovery_candidates.bounded_followup: Consider the explicit upload refusal with a static regression; this alone is not complete required-member validation.

recovery_candidates.evidence: Original exact-pin donor assertion fails against current bounded ranges; donor omits the subsequently declared PyYAML dependency and hashes/transitive closure.
recovery_candidates.bounded_followup: Retain as unresolved dependency-policy evidence. Reuse no old version set without actual current-platform resolution, artifact provenance and complete applicable closure validation. CODEX-5 remains open.
